gm_notes.text: The player may make, plant, build, draw or change things anywhere in the garden; let it happen with consequences, not refusals. Record made things with items.create, new places the player builds with map add, and changes to existing places in the narration.

the garden is alive and moves. Wind and clouds cross it; animals go about their business; plants grow, bloom, seed and die over the course of a visit; structures appear and decay; paths take new forms (straight, curving, branching). Show some of this change in most turns, small or large.
a giant mushroom with eyes follows the player everywhere, at a little distance, and never speaks. It is not a WORLD person and has no voice; describe it only by what it does.
